description: Defines data structures and functions for string-to-value maps, including strmap, strintmap, and strset, with initialization, manipulation, and iteration functionalities.

methods.name: strmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a strmap, with keys duplicated and managed by the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with custom memory pool and duplication options.

methods.name: strmap_clear
methods.description: Removes all entries from the strmap, freeing resources if specified.

methods.name: strmap_partial_clear
methods.description: Clears the strmap but retains table allocation for efficiency.

methods.name: strmap_put
methods.description: Inserts or overwrites an entry in the strmap with a string key and data pointer.

methods.name: strmap_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the internal entry for a given string key.

methods.name: strmap_get
methods.description: Returns the data pointer associated with a string key.

methods.name: strmap_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string key exists in the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_remove
methods.description: Removes a string key from the strmap, optionally freeing its value.

methods.name: strmap_get_size
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the strmap.

methods.name: strmap_empty
methods.description: Checks if the strmap is empty.

methods.name: strmap_for_each_entry
methods.description: Macro to iterate over entries in the strmap.

methods.name: strintmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a strintmap with a default integer value.

methods.name: strintmap_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a strintmap with custom options.

methods.name: strintmap_clear
methods.description: Clears the strintmap.

methods.name: strintmap_partial_clear
methods.description: Partially clears the strintmap.

methods.name: strintmap_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string exists in the strintmap.

methods.name: strintmap_remove
methods.description: Removes a string from the strintmap.

methods.name: strintmap_empty
methods.description: Checks if the strintmap is empty.

methods.name: strintmap_get_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the strintmap.

methods.name: strintmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value for a string key, or default if not found.

methods.name: strintmap_set
methods.description: Sets the integer value for a string key.

methods.name: strintmap_incr
methods.description: Increments the integer value for a string key.

methods.name: strset_init
methods.description: Initializes a string set.

methods.name: strset_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a string set with custom options.

methods.name: strset_clear
methods.description: Clears the string set.

methods.name: strset_partial_clear
methods.description: Partially clears the string set.

methods.name: strset_contains
methods.description: Checks if a string is in the set.

methods.name: strset_remove
methods.description: Removes a string from the set.

methods.name: strset_empty
methods.description: Checks if the set is empty.

methods.name: strset_get_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the set.

methods.name: strset_add
methods.description: Adds a string to the set.
